name: Weekly dependency-update review
summary: Each Monday, batch the open dependency-update pull requests, run the test suite on each, and ask one human to approve the safe ones in a single pass.

inputs.name: test_results
inputs.source: CI status checks on each pull request

steps.action: List open pull requests labelled 'dependencies' older than 24 hours
Tag each update patch, minor or major from its version change and read its changelog for breaking-change notes
Record pass or fail of the CI checks for each pull request
Write a one-page brief: patch/minor updates with green checks first, majors and red checks listed separately with the reason
Merge the pull requests the reviewer approved, one at a time, waiting for the main branch checks between merges

checkpoints.decision: Approve the listed safe updates as a batch; pick which majors to schedule
checkpoints.brief: The one-page brief with links to each pull request and its changelog excerpt

outputs.name: weekly brief
outputs.destination: comment on the pinned 'Dependency updates' issue

failure_handling: If main goes red after a merge, stop merging, revert that merge and add it to next week's brief as failed.
done_definition: Every open dependency pull request older than 24 hours appears in the brief
Each approved pull request is merged or listed with the reason it was not
The main branch checks are green after the last merge
